name: Open a member sub-account
description: Open a new sub-account of a given type for a member with an opening deposit, and return the confirmation number. This capability posts an irreversible transaction.
goal: Sign on as the operator, look up member {{memberId}}, open a new sub-account of type {{accountType}} with an opening deposit of {{openingDeposit}}, and reach the confirmation screen showing the confirmation number.

inputs.name: openingDeposit
inputs.description: Opening deposit amount in dollars. Minimum 25.
